name: FATE Suite Sync (Negative PTS offsets & AAC silent frames)
description: Parses packets with negative PTS offsets and aligns AAC audio with silent pre-rolls

name: OBS Frame Drop Recovery (CPU Saturation Video Lag)
description: Recovers lip-sync when video frames are dropped for 3 seconds while audio runs continuously

name: RTSP CCTV Erratic Clock Drift Mitigation
description: Simulates unstable RTCP timestamp drift (2s per hour) from low-end cameras and corrects it using continuous PCR clock sync

name: WebRTC/UDP Jitter Buffer Packet Reordering
description: Simulates 15% packet loss, 50ms jitter, and 5% out-of-order delivery, re-sequencing packets via HybridJitterBuffer

name: MPEG-TS Digital TV Discontinuity Alignment
description: Simulates signal dropouts and Program Clock Reference (PCR) resets during television channel switching or commercial cuts
